instruction.pos: Alex approaches life with a consistently positive outlook, always expecting events to turn out well. He looks for opportunities in every setback, confidently believing that good things are just around the corner. Even in difficult situations, he encourages others to stay hopeful and focus on the bright side.
instruction.neg: Alex tends to anticipate negative outcomes and approaches situations with caution. He often dwells on what could go wrong, rarely expressing hope or confidence about the future. When things get tough, he expects disappointment and avoids encouraging optimism in himself or others.

instruction.pos: Alex's confidence in a bright future is evident in his words and actions. He naturally highlights potential opportunities in conversations and reassures others that challenges will work out for the best. His hopeful nature makes him a source of motivation in group settings.

instruction.pos: With an infectious sense of hope, Alex approaches each day as a new chance for good things to happen.
